hook_en: He will be with you in trouble. 🙏
reflect_en: In these verses God Himself speaks about the one who loves Him and knows His name: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. Whatever this Tuesday brings, you can call out to Him and trust that you won't face it alone.
q_en: What trouble do you want to call out to God about today?
x_en: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble.
tiktok: You won't face it alone 🙏 Psalm 91:14–16 — When he calls out to Me, I will answer him
yt_title: I Will Be With Him in Trouble | Psalm 91:14–16 #Shorts
li_open: Presence in hard seasons matters more than answers.
li_quote: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble.
li_body: God's promise here is not that trouble will never come, but that He will answer and be with His people in it. Leaders who show up for their people in hard seasons, and pray with them instead of only advising them, reflect that same faithful presence.
hook_es: Él estará contigo en la angustia. 🙏
reflect_es: En estos versículos Dios mismo habla de quien ha puesto en Él su voluntad y ha conocido Su nombre: Me invocará, y yo le responderé: con él estaré yo en la angustia. Sea lo que sea que traiga este martes, puedes invocarle y confiar en que no lo enfrentarás solo.
q_es: ¿Por qué situación quieres invocar a Dios hoy?
x_es: Me invocará, y yo le responderé: con él estaré yo en la angustia: lo libraré, y le glorificaré.
key_en: I will be with him in trouble
key_es: con él estaré yo en la angustia
